changelog:
Massgram beta 12.5.6-beta1

- Removed the old global Telegram Premium override so the client no longer breaks core Telegram premium logic
- Switched premium text, todo and checklist messages to Massgram-only transport with a safe Unsupported fallback for regular clients
- Moved premium sticker delivery to the same Massgram-only payload format and kept premium indicators local to Massgram clients only
- Rolled back unsafe global speed overrides that caused jump-to-latest jank and startup instability, keeping only the safe Massgram transport changes
- Fixed one flood-wait check in the download path and restored Telegram-native queue limits for smoother loader behavior
